name: Interview scorecard block on home
acceptanceCriteria: A 'Recent interviews' card renders on the homepage after login, adjacent to readiness
If no sessions exist, the empty state shows a 'Start one' CTA pointing to /college-interviews
If sessions exist, at most 3 rows render, each with persona id, date, and overall /10 score
antiPatterns: Card shows raw NaN scores or '—/10' for all rows when data exists
Empty state missing — shows blank rectangle instead
